answer_1.quote: Text summarization techniques aim to generate a condensed and cohesive version of the input text... We propose a Correlational Copying Network (CoCoNet) for abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model with the official ROUGE toolkit. We report the F1 score of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: Since the readability and informativeness are difficult to measure automatically, three expert annotators are involved to conduct manual evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: They rate the readability and the informativeness on a scale of 1 to 5.
